U.S. MARINE CORPS - MOSS

Marine Corps ASVAB Scores

Minimum AFQT, how line scores work, and the score needed for every entry-level MOS

Minimum AFQT: 31

The Marine Corps requires an AFQT of at least 31 for applicants with a high school diploma.

How the Marine Corps Scores Jobs

The Marine Corps combines your section scores into four line scores: General Technical (GT), Mechanical Maintenance (MM), Electronics (EL), and Clerical (CL). Each MOS sets a minimum on one or more of them. Recruits usually enlist into a program field and are assigned a specific MOS during training.

CodeScoreMade from
GTGeneral TechnicalAR + MC + VE
MMMechanical MaintenanceAR + MC + EI + AS
ELElectronicsGS + AR + MK + EI
CLClericalMK + VE

Marine Corps line scores average 100, and most people score between 60 and 140. Marine GT adds Mechanical Comprehension, so it is calculated differently from Army GT.
